    Description

    EA SPORTS FC 27 is set to kick off on September 24, 2026, bringing its football action to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. Developed by EA CANADA and EA Romania and published by Electronic Arts, this installment continues the series' legacy of delivering top-notch sports simulation. Players will dive into The Grounds, a unique setting where the raw energy of street football merges with the grandeur of stadiums. It promises a deeper, more authentic experience with community-driven tweaks that heighten your control in every game mode. Whether you're a die-hard fan or a casual kicker, this one's got something for everyone.
